\parbox{\textwidth}{\footnotesize W0: scores frozen on 31 March 2026, labels counted from April to June 2026. W1: scores frozen on 30 June 2026, labels counted from July to September 2026. Spenders are the contracts that hold a positive latest allowance at the freeze; traders are the GMX~V2 accounts that hold contract code, are nodes of the freeze-date graph and close at least three positions in the label window. In the revised analysis 2{,}070 W0 spenders gained a new approval pair and 1{,}695 a new transfer sender, and 1{,}616 and 1{,}533 W1 spenders did; in the registered analysis 3{,}403, 3{,}042, 2{,}850 and 2{,}812. Of the 70 W1 traders, 9 had at least one liquidation. The degree, EndorseRank and AWP rows are reference scores; the companion study \cite{kwon2026companion} reports their comparisons in full. Intervals: 400 paired resamples over the contracts of the cohort, seed 42.}
